The Cat In The Corner, X:5

I’ve done my best to listen carefully to the Martin Hayes’s first version in his CD “The lonesome Touch”. His choice of keys is quite peculiar but rich for its color. As usual, when repeating the phrase, some rolls in the first part are obviously changed in 3 quavers or mixed with triplet ad libidum.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AXgdD-tAKUc

Re: The Cat In The Corner

Once again I must object to the lumper tendency of this database. “The Cat in the Corner” is simply not the same tune as “Port an Chonchobhúir” which appears here as #3. The A part has some similarities to be sure, but the B part is very different. I play both tunes and they sound very different to me. The two tunes both have a family resemblance to “The Thornton Jig,” which gets a separate entry in the database (as of course it should).

↳ Posted by lsanger on February 23rd, 2023.
